item.title: ISSS Town Hall: Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description:
ISSS is holding a Town Hall to share information about the recent regulatory change to Duration of Status (D/S) that affects individuals in F-1 and J-1 status and their dependents. This event is open to the campus community, and this session focus is on answering student questions. Join us virtually on Thursday, August 13, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Register here: https://tinyurl.com/RPI-DS-townhall

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
